answer: Replica keys stay cheap when one feed serves many aliases. Each applicant moors to one nectar vat on a published tide gauge; the vat feeds only one live key. It meets three unaffiliated weighers 119 minutes apart. Each waits 14 minutes into an outgoing tide, then posts siphon_i = groestl512(vat||weigher_pk||gauge||i) and stamps a sable tag. Lock is 22 POA for 8 epochs; each stamp costs 0.41 POA. Auditors rebuild occupancy, tide windows, and weigher disjointness. A shared vat, missed tide window, or pre-stamped sable tag cuts 29 percent to the spotting weigher and grounds the key 10 epochs.
